# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/license-inventory.mjs. Do not edit. -->

Studio's MIT `LICENSE` covers project code. npm packages and third-party artwork
retain their own terms. This inventory records declarations; it does not clear
copyright, attribution, source distribution, or font obligations.

The npm lock is the complete install input, including development tools. A
`production install` entry may or may not survive Vite tree shaking. The exact
browser bundle and the patched container package set still need artifact review.
The deployed site serves this notice at `/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

## Tracked visual assets

No font binary is tracked. The brand wordmark uses Pretendard outlines,
described in the brand asset README; the upstream declaration is [SIL OFL 1.1](https://github.com/orioncactus/pretendard/blob/main/LICENSE).

| Group | Paths | Distribution | Origin | Terms | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| brand-artwork | `assets/logo/kpubdata-brand-assets/*`, `assets/logo/social/*` | source archive; selected SVGs in browser bundle | KPubData Brand v2; wordmark paths based on Pretendard (brand assets README) | Pretendard declares SIL OFL 1.1; treatment of outlined paths needs review | needs review |
| product-screenshots | `assets/screenshots/*` | repository only | captured from this project's UI | screen content and any provider data shown need review | needs review |
| documentation-brand-copies | `docs/brand/assets/*` | repository documentation | copies of this project's brand artwork | same Pretendard-derived wordmark review as brand artwork | needs review |
| prototype-screenshots | `docs/prototype/warehouse/screens/*` | repository documentation | captured from this project's prototype | review any third-party data visible in the screenshots | needs review |
| visual-test-baselines | `e2e/visual.spec.ts-snapshots/*` | test source only | generated from this project's UI in Playwright | same rights as displayed assets and data | needs review |
| public-template-icons | `public/file.svg`, `public/globe.svg`, `public/window.svg` | browser static files and Docker image | source of original template icons is not documented | needs provenance and license review, even if the UI does not link to them | needs review |
| legacy-favicon | `src/app/favicon.ico` | repository; current page uses the Brand v2 SVG | generated from Brand v2 artwork (brand assets README) | same Pretendard-derived wordmark review as brand artwork | needs review |
